title: A V3 exit leaves its proceeds as WETH in the wallet and nothing ever unwraps them, while the bot buys, pays gas and checks its wallet floor in native ETH only

evidence.note: buildV3SellTx: exactInputSingle with tokenOut wethAddress (:391) and recipient walletAddress (:393), wrapped alone in multicall(deadline, [swapData]) (:400); no unwrapWETH9 in the batch, so SwapRouter02 pays WETH to the wallet
the decoder reads the V3 proceeds as "WETH Transfer to wallet (V3 path -- WETH sent directly without unwrap)": the WETH result is known to the code, but nothing converts it
checkWalletBalance reads httpProvider.getBalance (native ETH only); :387 the entry gate the same; WETH in the wallet counts for neither
buys send native ETH as value (also :748), so WETH proceeds cannot fund the next buy or any gas

evidence.ref: git grep -n -i -e "unwrapWETH9" -e ".withdraw(" -e "WETH_ABI" -- src scripts (at 23a6461 and HEAD)
evidence.note: WETH_ABI is used only by the receipt decoder; there is no WETH withdraw or unwrapWETH9 call anywhere in src or scripts

real ETH V3 snipe, stop-loss sell landed through the Flashbots bundle: the decoded multicall holds one exactInputSingle paying WETH to the wallet, no unwrapWETH9, and the wallet sends nothing in the minute after (claim v3-exit-proceeds-stay-weth); an unwrap in the batch and a WETH withdraw after the sell each read looks fixed (scratch src mutations, restored identical)

sibling_sites_checked: Every sell builder: buildV2SellTx (swapExactTokensForETH, the router unwraps and pays native ETH: not affected), executePublicFallbackSell (V2 swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens: native ETH, not affected), buildV3SellTx (affected; V3 has no public fallback, AUD-EXIT-007). The V3 snipe buy (bot.ts multicall with exactInputSingle, recipient the wallet, tokenOut the token) is not affected: it receives the token. scripts/ hold no unwrap. Affected chains: every chain with a V3 dex in its template (ETH uniswap-v3, BSC pancakeswap-v3 and uniswap-v3, Base and Arbitrum uniswap-v3), on every private route (Flashbots, bloXroute, passthrough), full and partial exits, anti-rug exits included.
severity_rationale: S3 (misleading behavior and ops friction), capital none, graded by the 23-07 executor under the operator's standing instruction of 2026-11-11 ("All the bugs are going to get fixed. The S1, 2 or whatever doesn't matter. Don't interrupt sessions to ask me about upgrading or downgrading"), without a stop. No funds are lost (WETH is redeemable 1:1) and the recorded proceeds are right, but every V3 exit moves trading capital out of the native balance the bot spends: buys, gas for later exits and the wallet-floor checks see less than the wallet holds, so the bot can pause or refuse buys early, and the operator must unwrap by hand. Not S2: the wallet floor keeps native gas in reserve for exits, so no exit is left without gas by this alone (code read, not run).
recommendation: Phase 29: make the V3 exit pay native ETH (exactInputSingle with recipient the router, then unwrapWETH9(minOut, wallet) in the same multicall; the minimum ties to AUD-EXIT-001), or unwrap WETH after each V3 exit; until then count WETH in the balance and floor checks. test/realpath/triage/AUD-EXIT-027.test.ts reads looks fixed for both shapes. Nothing is fixed in Phase 23.

triage.note: Found by 23-07 while proving AUD-EXIT-001: a real ETH V3 stop-loss sell landed through the Flashbots bundle decodes as multicall([exactInputSingle(tokenOut WETH, recipient the wallet)]) with no unwrapWETH9, and the wallet sends nothing in the minute after, so the proceeds stay WETH (claim v3-exit-proceeds-stay-weth); an unwrap in the batch and a WETH withdraw after each read looks fixed. Not in the frozen population; recorded so check.ts can locate its claim.
